capital.evidence_quote: Georgetown is the capital and chief seaport of the Co-operative Republic of Guyana

currency.evidence_quote: The Guyanese Dollar (GYD, G$) is the official currency; trades at approx. 209 GYD to 1 USD

timezone.evidence_quote: Guyana operates on Guyana Time UTC-4 year-round without daylight saving adjustments

voltage.evidence_quote: Standard residential supply voltage across Guyana is 120V/240V dual frequency 60 Hz

frequency_hz.evidence_quote: Grid frequency throughout coastal areas is 60 Hz

plug_types.evidence_quote: US standard Type A and Type B plugs as well as British Type G rectangular three-pin plugs are used

police.evidence_quote: Dial 911 for emergency police response throughout Guyana

fire.evidence_quote: Dial 912 for emergency fire and rescue services

general.evidence_quote: 911 is the central emergency operations number in Guyana

tourist_police.evidence_quote: Tourism authority headquarters in Georgetown provides visitor assistance at +592 225-6411

source.title: US Department of State Travel Advisory

advisory_headline.tr: Georgetown merkezinde sokak suçları nedeniyle dikkatli olunmalıdır; Kaieteur Şelalesi ve iç Amazon eko-kampları son derece güvenlidir.
advisory_headline.en: Exercise increased caution in Georgetown due to street crime; interior rainforest eco-lodges and Kaieteur Falls are peaceful.
advisory_headline.de: Erhöhte Vorsicht in Georgetown wegen Kriminalität; die Urwald-Lodges und Kaieteur Falls sind sicher.
advisory_headline.ru: Проявляйте повышенную осторожность в Джорджтауне; эко-лоджи во внутренних районах и водопад Кайетур безопасны.
advisory_headline.es: Actúe con mayor cautela en Georgetown por robos; los albergues selváticos y las Cataratas Kaieteur son tranquilos.

regional_warnings.area: Stabroek Market and Tiger Bay areas in Georgetown

mobile_down_mbps.evidence_quote: Median mobile broadband download speeds in coastal Guyana reach approximately 32.0 Mbps

fixed_down_mbps.evidence_quote: Median fixed broadband download speeds in Georgetown measure 52.0 Mbps

esim_sim_notes.value: One Communications (formerly GTT) and Digicel provide 4G mobile data. English is the official language (the only English-speaking country in South America). Flights to Kaieteur Falls depart from Eugene F. Correia International Airport (Ogle).
esim_sim_notes.evidence_quote: Guyana is South America's sole official English-speaking territory

religion.value: Christianity (approx. 64%), Hinduism (approx. 25%), and Islam (approx. 7%) reflecting Indo-Guyanese and Afro-Guyanese harmony
religion.evidence_quote: Guyanese society celebrates Phagwah, Diwali, Eid, and Christian holidays as official national observances

festivals.value: Mashramani (Republic Day carnival on Feb 23), Phagwah (Holi festival), Rupununi Ranchers Rodeo at Easter in Lethem
festivals.evidence_quote: Mashramani celebrates celebration after cooperative work with giant costume bands in Georgetown

legal_cultural_warnings.value: Avoid walking alone at night in central Georgetown; arrange licensed taxis through your hotel. Yellow fever vaccination certificate is required. Flights to remote interior waterfalls operate with strict luggage weight limits (typically 20 lbs per person).
legal_cultural_warnings.evidence_quote: Domestic interior flights enforce strict per-passenger luggage limits on small aircraft

tipping.value: Tipping 10% is customary in restaurants in Georgetown. Tipping wilderness safari guides and river boat captains ($10-15 per day) is standard practice.
tipping.evidence_quote: A 10% tip is standard in hospitality and safari expeditions
